why: Hornet / Super Hornet windscreen: a flat centre pane (the plate behind the HUD combiner) between two slim posts, with curved quarter panes beyond the posts and a blown one-piece canopy bubble behind the windscreen arch (DCS F/A-18C Lot 20 and War Thunder F/A-18E external models, photos). Only the centre pane is flat; it is checked in z slices because the posts converge forward, and the HUD combiner (under the pane) is excluded by the slices' y range.
